description: This file defines the interface 'FileUrlGeneratorInterface' in the Drupal core, specifying methods for generating and transforming file URLs, including absolute, relative, and URL objects, for local and external files.

methods.name: generateString
methods.description: Creates a root-relative web-accessible URL string for a given file URI, possibly using CDN or remote stream wrapper.

methods.name: generateAbsoluteString
methods.description: Creates an absolute web-accessible URL string for a given file URI.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a URL object for a given file URI, which can be absolute or relative.

methods.name: transformRelative
methods.description: Transforms an absolute URL of a local file into a relative URL, optionally relative to the root path.
